evidence.quote: As long as incoming information about the economy remains broadly consistent with this outlook, the current stance of monetary policy likely will remain appropriate.
Moreover, inflation expectations, those measured by both surveys and market prices, have moved lower and reside at the low end of a range I consider consistent with our price-stability mandate.
The U.S. economy begins the year 2020 in a good place.
We are not seeing any evidence to date that a strong labor market is putting excessive cost-push pressure on price inflation.
it may be appropriate to gradually transition away from active repo operations this year as Treasury bill purchases supply a larger base of reserves

parsed.rationale: The speech signals an on-hold stance with a strong economy, but highlights muted inflation, lower inflation expectations and global headwinds, giving a slight dovish tilt. Balance sheet remarks are technical reserve management rather than a policy stance.
